mrr_comparability.comparison_rule: Use flat MRR@100 vs hierarchical MRR@100. Recall@200 and MRR@200 are reported separately for hierarchical only unless a flat depth-200 artifact exists.

conflict_flag_analysis.reason: The corpus audit reports source-level conflicting duplicate groups, but Fase C case_summary contains no deterministic per-case conflict flag. No conflict stratum is computed to avoid inferred labels.

methodology.version: hierarchical_v0.1 corpus evaluated in EXP-04 v0.2
methodology.hierarchical_text: section + chapter + partida 4D + HS6 nullable + NANDINA 8D + unidad fisica; fragments deduplicated by normalized text
methodology.unit_doc: one hierarchical document row per NANDINA-8 source row; final evaluation ranking unit is unique NANDINA-8 code
methodology.duplicate_code_resolution: first BM25 occurrence by score order wins
methodology.leakage_controls: No DAM/SERIE/true label/historical/flat outputs used as retrieval features; no LLM/RAG/dense/candidate pools used.

large_file_assessment.name: normative_hierarchical_results.csv
large_file_assessment.reason_for_size: Stores up to 200 effective candidates for each of 1056 cases, including BM25 scores and truncated candidate_text snippets.
large_file_assessment.redundancy_assessment: Partially redundant for aggregate metrics because case_summary is sufficient for Top-k/MRR and results can recalculate hierarchy; not deleted or modified in this microaudit.
